Free AI visibility audit

Ask ChatGPT for the best [your trade] in your city. Are you in the answer?

A lot of your customers don't Google anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity. We ask all three the seven questions your customers ask, screenshot every answer, and count how many times you're named out of 21. Usually it's not you. That's the audit, and it's free.
